title: 第153章 云织仙第154章 金剪银针
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
莫干山中溪流不断，树木连绵如海。
层层青峦被终年不散的云雾遮住，远远望去，只有几道黛青色的山尖浮在云雾之上。
云舒闲庭就在莫干山深处，但庭院外布有云雾禁制。
寻常凡人踏入，偶尔只会看到飞檐中的一角从云雾中露了出来，循着飞檐找去，却什么都找不到。
民间偶有樵夫、采药人远远望见过，便流传下来一个名字，叫“云楼”，说是神仙居住的地方，说的倒也大差不差。
唯有身负一定道行的修士，或者是仙神之属，才能破开雾障，寻到深处的云舒闲庭。
纪风有阴阳法眼，这些云雾禁制对他来说，并不算什么。
他带着知白、牛渊和绾绾，一路跨溪穿林，拨开重重云雾，行至一处半山腹地。
眼前云雾陡然散去，前方出现一条青石小路。
沿着青石小路蜿蜒而上，尽头便是一座庭院。
白墙黛瓦，飞檐翘角，静静卧在桑林和竹海之间。
走到庭院前，两扇木制大门对合关闭。
上边的门环是素面铜环，衔于兽首辅面之上，铜环上蒙着一层薄绿苔痕。
看得出来，这庭院已经有些年头了，门楣上写着：
“云舒闲庭。”
“公子，我去敲门。”
知白跑上前去，踮起脚，伸手刚好够到门环，用力扣了扣。
“咚咚咚！”
几声沉实的闷响穿透云雾，在静谧的庭院内缓缓传开。
知白等了一会儿，门里没有任何动静。

他扭过头来，看向纪风道：“公子，难道这庭院的主人不在家？”
“我再敲敲。”
知白正准备再敲门，忽然“咯吱”一声，大门从里边拉开一条缝。
一个小孩探出头来，穿着件短褂，身形清瘦。
“你们找谁？”
知白见来人和他一般大小，自然不能输了气场，大声说道：
“我家公子听闻云舒闲庭制作仙衣手法精妙，不远千里，特来登门，想定制一件仙衣，还请通传你家大人一声！”
那小孩站在门里，目光从知白身上扫过，又看向身后的纪风和牛渊等人，上下打量了一番。
这时，纪风脑海中《山海万灵录》翻过一页。
【玉尺郎】
【量尺成精，本体为羊脂白玉所制的仙尺，上刻天庭度量符文，其性沉稳，做事一丝不苟，专司量身定寸，经他度量，尺寸分毫不差。】
【获神通：缩地成寸】
纪风看着书页上的记载，再看看眼前的小童，心中了然。
一柄仙尺，有了灵，化了人形。
见纪风等人并非坏人，玉尺郎将门拉开了些许，端端正正的朝几人行了一礼。
“见过几位贵客，还请稍等片刻，我去通报我家仙子。”
纪风回礼道：“有劳了。”
玉尺郎转身快步往里跑去。
不到片刻，他便跑了回来，推开两扇大门，侧身做出引路姿势。
“几位客人，我家仙子有请，请随我来。”

“请！”
纪风等人迈过庭院门槛，跟着玉尺郎往院中走去。
入目是一座典型的江南庭院，木格花窗，廊檐下悬着细竹帘，山风一吹过，便轻轻晃动。
content_en:
Mogan Mountain has constant streams and trees stretching like the sea.
Layers of green mountains are covered by clouds and mist that persist all year round. From a distance, only a few dark blue mountain tops float above the clouds and mist.
Yunshu Xianting is located deep in Mogan Mountain, but there are clouds and fog restrictions outside the courtyard.
When ordinary mortals step in, they will occasionally see a corner of the cornice peeking out from the clouds and mist. If they follow the cornice, they will find nothing.
Occasionally, woodcutter and herb collectors among the people saw it from a distance, and a name was passed down, called "Yun Tower". It was said to be a place where gods lived, and it was quite accurate.
Only monks with certain spiritual skills, or those belonging to immortals and gods, can break through the fog barrier and find the deep Yunshu Xianting.
Ji Feng has the Yin-Yang Dharma Eye, and these cloud and mist restrictions are nothing to him.
He took Zhibai, Niu Yuan and Wanwan all the way across the stream and through the forest, pushing through the heavy clouds and fog, and arrived at a hinterland in the middle of the mountain.
The clouds and fog suddenly dispersed in front of me, and a bluestone path appeared in front of me.
Winding along the bluestone path, there is a courtyard at the end.
It has white walls and dark tiles, and upturned eaves and corners, lying quietly between the mulberry forest and the sea of ​​bamboo.
Walking to the courtyard, two wooden doors closed together.
The upper door knocker is a plain copper ring, which is attached to the auxiliary surface of the animal head. The copper ring is covered with a thin layer of green moss marks.
It can be seen that this courtyard has been around for some time. The lintel reads:
"Yunshu Xianting."
"Sir, I'm going to knock on the door."
Zhibai ran forward, stood on tiptoes, stretched out his hand to just reach the door knocker, and buttoned it hard.
"Dong dong dong!"
Several deep muffled sounds penetrated the clouds and mist, slowly spreading in the quiet courtyard.
Zhibai waited for a while, but there was no movement at the door.
He turned around, looked at Ji Feng and said, "Sir, is the owner of this courtyard not at home?"
"I'll knock again."
Zhibai was about to knock on the door again when suddenly there was a creak and the door opened a crack from the inside.
A child poked his head out. He was wearing a short coat and had a slim figure.
"Who are you looking for?"
When Zhibai saw that the visitor was about the same size as him, he naturally couldn't lose his aura and said loudly:
"My young master heard that Yun Shu Xianting's craftsmanship in making fairy clothes is exquisite. He traveled thousands of miles to come here. He wants to customize a fairy clothes. Please let your master know!"
The child stood in the door, his eyes swept over Zhibai, then looked at Ji Feng, Niu Yuan and others behind him, looking up and down.
At this time, a page of "The Records of Mountains and Seas" turned over in Ji Feng's mind.
【Yu Chilang】
[The measuring ruler is refined. The main body is an immortal ruler made of mutton-fat white jade, with heavenly measurement runes engraved on it. He is calm in nature and meticulous in his work. He specializes in measuring people's measurements. When he measures them, the dimensions are accurate. 】
[Acquire magical power: shrink the ground into an inch]
Ji Feng looked at the records on the page, then looked at the child in front of him, and he understood clearly.
A fairy ruler has a spirit and takes the form of a human being.
Seeing that Ji Feng and others were not bad people, Yu Chilang opened the door a little and bowed to them in an upright manner.
"I have seen some distinguished guests. Please wait a moment while I go to inform my fairy."
Ji Feng replied: "Thank you."
Yuchilang turned around and ran inside quickly.
Within a moment, he ran back, pushed open the two doors, and turned sideways to guide the way.
"My fairy has invited some guests, please come with me."
"Please!"
Ji Feng and others crossed the threshold of the courtyard and followed Yuchilang into the courtyard.
What you see is a typical Jiangnan courtyard, with wooden lattice windows and thin bamboo curtains hanging under the eaves, which sway gently when the mountain wind blows by.
